sources.title: BanglaFake: Constructing and Evaluating a Specialized Bengali Deepfake ...
sources.snippet: The fake audio generation process begins with a sequence of phonemes derived by pre-processing the Bangla Text Dataset. This sequence is processed by a Text Encoder to produce a hidden text representation that conditions a stochastic duration predictor, which samples the duration for each phoneme.

sources.title: Free AI Image & Deepfake Detector Online | FaceOnLive
sources.snippet: A deepfake detector is an AI tool that analyzes an image to determine whether it is a real photo or synthetic media created or manipulated by AI. Upload a photo and our deep-learning model examines pixel-level artifacts, lighting, and facial inconsistencies invisible to the human eye, then returns a real-or-fake result with a confidence score. Yes.
